note: Global staff identities and rate-limit identifiers are separate from tenant customers. Hashes remain nonexportable; raw email and source IP are explicitly classified.

structures.Sha256Digest: Opaque 32-byte cryptographic digest for integrity/request identity/capability verification; never raw token, body or contact data.

subject.identity_path: users.id (global staff identity; separate from customers)

subject.null_subject_policy: Global staff authentication identifier; may be an unknown account, never join it to a customer by email.

erase.reason: Bounded security rate-limit evidence for global staff authentication, including unknown identifiers; customer erase must not disable shared anti-abuse enforcement. Identity module must implement its own retention/expiry policy.

subject.null_subject_policy: Global staff identifier plus request IP; unknown accounts/IPs are not customer identity proof.
